{"reason":"V1’s 34 supplier switches cost 45,000 each and accompany all four stockouts; alert-planner costs 35,000 and always arrives in time. Replacing that branch should reduce total cost from 2,165,000 to 1,225,000 and stockouts from 4 to 0, including the medium 2.8- and 5.3-day failures, without raising either gate metric.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
